entries.title: CoreGuard Elite — Zero-Trust Mobile Endpoint Platform
entries.summary: Elite adds on-device Dynamic Threat Score (Quilla quantum-inspired), Overlay Protection Matrix, StrongBox forensic journal, and Scam Guard — not a cloud LLM or Play Protect clone.
entries.body: CoreGuard Elite correlates RASP/BAE hooks, overlay and Accessibility surfaces, Nemesis detections, and swarm alerts into a Dynamic Threat Score using classical weights plus QuillaQuantumCorrelate. The Overlay Protection Matrix audits draw-over-apps and third-party Accessibility holders and journals elevated findings; Play apps cannot silently kill other apps' overlays. The Forensic Journal is an append-only SHA-256 chain encrypted at rest with HardwareKeyManager (StrongBox→TEE). Scam Guard parses notification text locally for phishing URLs when the user grants Notification access. No raw logs leave the device for these features.
entries.defense: Open Overlay Matrix after new installs. Export Forensic Journal JSON/CSV for IT after an incident. Enable Notification access for Scam Guard. Ask Quilla "dynamic threat score" or "elite platform" for this brief. Treat DTS as a correlator — not zero-day omniscience.

entries.title: Dynamic Threat Score — On-Device Correlation
entries.summary: DTS is a weighted on-device correlator with Quilla quantum-inspired collapse — not an NPU small language model and not a signature-only AV.
entries.body: Traditional mobile AV leans on static hashes. Elite DTS watches live signals: hook pressure, overlay/a11y abuse, Nemesis scan pressure, swarm alerts, and BehavioralAnomalyEngine samples. Quilla's classical H·Metatron → CNOT → Rz·Raphael → Measure·Sandalphon circuit blends amplitudes when evidence co-fires. Scores map to CLEAR / WATCH / ELEVATED / CRITICAL. Elevated bands append to the Forensic Journal once per band transition.
entries.defense: If DTS is ELEVATED or CRITICAL, stop sensitive banking, run Nemesis, open Overlay Matrix, revoke untrusted Accessibility, and arm Privacy Shield.

entries.title: Scam Guard — On-Device Smishing Heuristics
entries.summary: Scam Guard inspects notification text and pasted URLs locally against IOC domains and zero-trust heuristics — amber pill on the Elite dashboard when score ≥ 50.
entries.body: Phishing in SMS, WhatsApp, and Telegram often arrives as links. With Notification Listener access granted by the user, CoreGuard parses title/text locally, extracts URLs, and scores IP literals, deep subdomain chains, credential-bait paths, risky TLDs, brand-spoof hosts, and on-device IOC hits. Findings can be journaled. No cloud LLM reads your messages.
entries.defense: Grant Notification access only if you want live inspection. Paste suspicious links into Scam Guard. Never enter credentials on amber-flagged hosts.
